# Licensing

## Rfast-derived translation

The supplied Rfast package declares `GPL (>= 2.0)`. The translated Rfast-derived Fortran source is therefore distributed under **GPL-2.0-or-later**. The complete supplied source tree is retained under `upstream/` for provenance.

## zigg-fortran dependency

`vendor/zigg-fortran/` is the previously translated zigg package and remains separately documented as **GPL-2.0-or-later**. Its upstream attribution and license material are retained inside the vendored package.

`LICENSE` contains the GNU GPL version 2 text. Under the upstream "version 2 or later" grant, recipients may use GPL version 2 or any later GPL version.
